eis_specs.document_title: Bungama Solar — DAC source (v3.31.0 hybrid source-hunt)
eis_specs.notes: Solar 280 MWac. BESS 250 MW / 700 MWh (2.8h duration). Regime: DAC. Approved SA project ~6 km east of Port Pirie on 530 ha. Owned by EPS/Revera Energy (part of Bungama Battery Pty Ltd). Original approval mid-2019 (280 MW solar + 140 MW BESS); staged BESS scaled to 250 MW/700 MWh with Stage 1 (150 MW/300 MWh) already commissioned by Enerven 2026. Solar farm is Stage 3 (still to be built).
